hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mts|*.cts) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; out=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1) || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":%s}}\n' "$(printf 'tsc --noEmit reported errors after this edit. Fix them before moving on:\n%s' "$out" | jq -Rs .)"; }
